name: Kiki-Jiki + Zealous Conscripts
description: Kiki-Jiki can copy Zealous Conscripts to untap and create infinite combat-phase steals.

name: Painter's Servant + Grindstone
description: Painter's Servant sets a color which Grindstone can use to mill the library to zero iteratively.

name: Isochron Scepter + Dramatic Reversal
description: Imprint Dramatic Reversal on Isochron Scepter with enough mana rocks to generate infinite mana.

name: Deadeye Navigator + Palinchron
description: Soulbond or blink Palinchron with Deadeye Navigator to untap lands repeatedly and generate infinite mana.

name: Splinter Twin + Deceiver Exarch (Kiki style)
description: Enchant Deceiver Exarch with Splinter Twin to create a token copy and produce infinite creatures.

name: Felidar Guardian + Restoration Angel
description: Blink loop: cast Felidar Guardian; its ETB blinks Restoration Angel; Restoration Angel's ETB blinks Felidar Guardian; repeat to generate infinite enters/leaves triggers (and infinite flicker). Requires both creatures and a legal way to stack triggers as typical in Commander play.
notes: A classic 2-card blink combo — detected as complete when both cards are present in the deck.

name: Gleaming Splendor + Smothering Tithe + Exalted Sunborn (Treasure loop, conditional)
description: Loop outline: activate Gleaming Splendor to force opponents to draw; Smothering Tithe triggers create Treasures when opponents don't pay; with Exalted Sunborn doubling/creating additional triggers or interaction and multiple opponents failing to pay, you can generate repeated Treasure gain and sac them for mana to replay Gleaming Splendor. This combo is conditional on opponents not paying Smothering Tithe triggers and on table state (number of opponents, triggers).
notes: Marked conditional — analyzer will flag this as a potential combo and include the textual explanation; because it depends on opponents' choices the tool labels it 'conditional' and does not assume guaranteed infinite output.
